description: Solana validator snapshot from the public RPC: active and delinquent validator counts, total active stake in SOL, stake-weighted commission, cluster skip rate over the latest epoch block production, and the top validators by stake with their commission and skip rate. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_solana_token_extensions when you need Solana SPL mint audit from the chain: program, authorities; crypto_jupiter_solana_routing when you need Jupiter aggregator quote on Solana for an exact-input swap. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
